summary.text: A dead egg of the ancient desolate beast worldly sand gull, held as a material that can turn ordinary sand into sand gull soil.

claims.text: In Lan clan’s sand gull breeding cave, Fang Yuan finds a huge egg on a stone table, its shell cracked with small holes and transparent egg white leaking onto yellow sand. It is an egg of the ancient desolate beast worldly sand gull; the life inside has already perished, so it is a dead egg. Life essence in the egg can raise ordinary sand gull fertility when used superficially, but Fang Yuan’s use is different: he extracts that life essence with a Gu formation, condenses it into light yellow juice, and turns ordinary sand into sand gull soil to feed connect luck Immortal Gu.
Looking at the egg’s condition, it could still produce another fifteen thousand kilograms of sand gull soil, three feeding sessions for connect luck Immortal Gu at five thousand kilograms each.
In the center of Fang Yuan’s blessed land, storerooms hold immortal materials that include the giant dead egg of the worldly sand gull among other stock.
At the center of a sand gull soil beach in Mini Western Desert, the dead egg remains cracked and leaking egg white; its life essence can still turn ordinary sand into sand gull soil.
